define_mrp_process_with_conda_runtime: define an MRP process named proc using a Conda runtime with python>=3.7 dependency
define_mrp_process_with_host_runtime: define an MRP process using a Host runtime to run a shell command directly
define_mrp_process_with_docker_runtime: define an MRP process using a Docker runtime to run a command inside a container
run_mrp_main_cli: run the MRP main CLI entrypoint to manage defined processes with up, down, and info commands
import_msetup_processes: import another msetup.py file to load its process definitions into the current MRP context
